summary: Validate finite catalog options and new-since limits, reject conflicting output flags, verify catalog access in doctor within the command timeout, describe the actual MCP surface, and save new-since snapshots only after delivery.
reason: Misleading input and output, a false health result, stale MCP guidance, and premature snapshots can hide errors or new products.
validated_outcome: Offline tests cover finite catalog options, new-since limits, conflicting output flags, dry-run catalog skip, bounded catalog retry, MCP context, and delivery-before-snapshot ordering.
